Property.PublicRemarks: Akasha is one of Whistler's most iconic and architecturally significant mountain estates, a luxurious ski-in chalet poised on the prestigious Sunridge Plateau. This masterpiece of luxury craftsmanship is defined by a majestic 400-year-old red cedar tree rising through the center of its grand spiral staircase blending rustic elegance with timeless design. This 6 bedroom, 7 bathroom luxury chalet offers unparalleled amenities for a world-class alpine experience, making it the ultimate private sanctuary just a short walk to Whistler Village. Additional features include a state-of-the-art media room, wine cellar, spectacular spa with an indoor lap pool and cascading waterfall, a steam room, outdoor hot tub carved from stone - all offering sweeping views of the Whistler Valley.

In West Vancouver’s exclusive Whitby Estates, this world-class residence commands sweeping 180-degree ocean views from downtown Vancouver and Stanley Park to Vancouver Island’s majestic peaks. With five luxurious bedroom suites and eight bathrooms, including a private lower-level guest suite, it masterfully balances grand-scale entertaining with refined daily living. Highlights include expansive principal rooms, two sensational chef’s kitchens paired with an outdoor kitchen, and a dedicated entertainment level featuring a stylish wet bar, temperature-controlled wine display, state-of-the-art home theatre, Technogym fitness studio, and elegant private office, all integrated with Crestron smart automation. Just 15 minutes from downtown Vancouver and under 90 minutes to Whistler, this iconic estate epitomizes refined coastal luxury, where breathtaking natural beauty and sophisticated design create an extraordinary lifestyle.
